title: CMake target inspection can execute an unqueued reconfigure
body: The seemingly read-only command cmake --build build/wsl --target help triggered CMake reconfiguration and codegen outside the global with-test-lock queue. The build workflow should expose a non-executing target-list query or fail early when invoked without the queue; the exact accidental command was cmake --build build/wsl --target help, and the intended workflow is the queued VIXEN build target.

title: Pinned VIXEN codegen does not vendor the generated VoxelDocument face
body: Pinning the private kernel join regenerated RecipeSimd and dispatch, but the joined document-default contract left VIXEN/libraries/SVO/include/Recipe/generated/VoxelDocument.g.h stale. I had to run the kernel SourceGenerator VoxelDocumentEmitterTests with UPDATE_GOLDENS=1, then manually copy Packages/com.utility.sdf/Runtime/GPU/Generated/VoxelDocument.g.h into VIXEN. The consumer pin/codegen target should materialize and check all generated faces together.

title: Windowed VIXEN GPU witnesses require manual DISPLAY provisioning
body: The documented queued GPU environment exports Vulkan variables but does not set DISPLAY or unset WAYLAND_DISPLAY for the editor's windowed capture. The first queued witness exited 255 before AppFlow with glfwInit failed (DISPLAY=<unset>); rerunning with DISPLAY=:0 and unset WAYLAND_DISPLAY passed. The queue/capture helper should provision the documented windowed environment automatically.
